stem: Malli picks whole black peppers out of his pulao, yet farmers do not handpick husk from a heap of threshed wheat. Which reason best explains this difference?

stem: A mixture contains fine sand, mustard seeds and whole chickpeas. Sieve P has holes slightly bigger than mustard seeds; Sieve Q has holes slightly smaller than mustard seeds but bigger than sand grains. Which plan separates all three?
